settings.heading: Blooming in the North
settings.subheading: Designed in Norway. Inspired by the beauty of the North.

settings.heading: BLÓMINOR
settings.text: The name BLÓMINOR comes from the idea of blooming in the North. It brings together blóm, the Old Norse word for flower, with the Norwegian words i nord, meaning 'in the North.' The name reflects the wildflowers that bloom between stone, forest and fjord, bringing colour to the northern landscape through the changing seasons.

settings.body:
From an early age, founder and creative director Aisha Nazir Ahmed was drawn to the beauty and craftsmanship of fine jewellery. She was fascinated by how gemstones, colours and small details could hold emotion, memories and meaning. During her travels, she often brought home small pieces of jewellery — personal treasures that reminded her of special places and moments.

As she grew older, her interest became deeper. She began learning about gemstones, materials and jewellery design, and started imagining pieces of her own. She loved the artistry of high jewellery, but often felt that it was out of reach for many people.

This inspired her to create something different: beautifully designed jewellery in sterling silver, made with colour and thoughtful details. Pieces that feel special, but can still be enjoyed by more people — at celebrations, gatherings and in everyday life.

This vision became even clearer when she became a mother. Her daughter helped her see the beauty in small, everyday moments in a new way. Jewellery did not have to be saved only for rare occasions or important milestones. It could be worn simply because it brought happiness to an ordinary day.

This became the foundation of BLÓMINOR — jewellery created for hverdagsglede, the Norwegian feeling of finding joy in the little things that make an ordinary day feel special.

Inspired by Nordic wildflowers, forests, fjords and the changing northern light, each piece brings together colour, softness and botanical details. The jewellery is designed to be worn, enjoyed and made part of your own memories.

We believe you should not have to wait for a milestone, a special occasion or for someone else to choose something beautiful for you. Jewellery can be a gift to yourself — chosen simply because it brings you joy.

settings.quote: Jewellery can be a gift to yourself — chosen simply because it brings you joy.

settings.title: Hverdagsglede
settings.content: The Norwegian feeling of finding joy in the little things that make an ordinary day feel special. Jewellery does not have to be saved only for rare occasions or important milestones. It can be worn simply because it brings happiness to an ordinary day.

settings.title: Inspired by Scandinavia
settings.content: From the soft colours of long summer evenings to the cooler light reflected across snow, water and winter skies. Shades of fjord blue, lavender, soft pink, forest green and silver flow through the designs, creating a world shaped by Nordic nature, light and colour.
